content.text:
**Finding submitted: deviation (EXCLUSIVITY), preferred-level cure.**

- **Responsive locations reviewed:** §12.3 (p0044 — express no-exclusivity disclaimer, benefits us), §7.2 first instance (p0026 — disclose-and-match, an MFN/right-to-match mechanic, not exclusivity), §2.1 (take-or-pay minimum volume, a separate commitment rule), §12.4 first instance (non-solicit), and §12.4 second instance (p0046).
- **Problem:** p0046 bars Customer from *acquiring* any competing product or service for the term plus 24 months in any territory — a de facto sole-supplier restraint with no category limit, no 12-month cap and no service-level/delivery-failure exit (walk-away territory), and it contradicts §12.3.
- **Cure:** single surgical replace deleting the "acquire" prong ("develop, market, sell, or acquire" → "develop, market, or sell"), restoring the preferred position without touching unrelated wording or duplicating the MFN mechanic.
